subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
unit: Unit 4: Jobs in Airports and Aviation (Listening & Speaking)
lesson: Jobs in airports: matching, Listening 4.4.1 and asking for/giving explanations
outcomes: Match airport jobs with their responsibilities
Listen to an air traffic controller and answer questions
Use phrases to ask for and give explanations

tf.s: Tariq Al Kharousi works as an air traffic controller.
tf.why: Yes, he works at the new Muscat Airport.

tf.s: Tariq has worked in air traffic control for just over 22 years.
tf.why: Correct, he has many years of experience.

tf.s: An air traffic controller needs a passion for aviation and to be good at science.
tf.why: Right, Tariq says these are important.

tf.s: Tariq says his job is easy and has short hours.
tf.why: It is stressful, with long working periods and lots of concentration.

tf.s: Tariq says his job is stressful but rewarding.
tf.why: Yes, it is hard but it makes him feel good.

tf.s: Tariq decides the landing order only by the colour of each plane.
tf.why: He uses the size, speed and direction of each plane.

tf.s: 'What do you mean by...?' is a phrase to ask for an explanation.
tf.why: Correct, you use it when you don't understand something.

tf.s: 'That's because...' is a phrase to ask a question.
tf.why: It is used to give an explanation.

tf.s: The control tower at the new Muscat airport is 97 metres tall.
tf.why: Yes, the lead-in facts give 97 m.

tf.s: The new Muscat airport runway is 40 kilometres long.

boxes.why: Tariq directs aircraft safely as an air traffic controller.

boxes.q: What does an air traffic controller do?
boxes.why: Controllers guide planes so they land and take off safely.

boxes.q: How long has Tariq worked in air traffic control?
boxes.why: He has just over 22 years of experience.
Let me explain introduces an explanation.

boxes.q: Which phrase asks for an explanation?
boxes.why: Can you tell us about... asks for information.

boxes.q: How tall is the control tower at Muscat airport?
How does Tariq describe his job?
boxes.why: It is hard but it gives him satisfaction.

boxes.q: What subject should a controller be good at?
Where do planes land and take off?
boxes.why: The runway is the long strip used by planes.

hunt.q: Tariq's years in air traffic control

mcq.q: Which is a quality needed to be an air traffic controller?
mcq.why: Tariq says you need a passion for aviation.

mcq.q: Which phrase do we use to ask for an explanation?
mcq.why: What do you mean by... asks someone to explain.

mcq.q: When did the first Airbus 330 land at Muscat's new airport?
mcq.why: The lead-in photo shows the first landing on 14 December 2014.

mcq.q: Where does an air traffic controller work?
mcq.why: Controllers watch the planes from the control tower.

mcq.q: Your friend says 'My job is rewarding.' You don't understand the word. What do you say?
mcq.why: This phrase asks for an explanation of a word.

mcq.q: Someone asks why you want to be a pilot. How do you start your answer?
mcq.why: The reason is... introduces an explanation.

mcq.q: The airport will grow from 12 million to 48 million passengers. How many times bigger is that?
Why is air traffic control not a job with short hours?
o: it involves long working periods and needs concentration
controllers work one hour a week
mcq.why: Tariq explains the job needs long hours and focus.

mcq.q: How does Tariq decide the landing order?
o: by the size and speed of each plane and the direction it comes from
by the name of the airline
by the colour of each plane
by the price of the tickets
mcq.why: He considers size, speed and direction.

mcq.q: Why does Tariq call his job rewarding even though it is stressful?
o: keeping aircraft safe gives him satisfaction
mcq.why: Doing an important job well feels rewarding.
